title: [FEAT]: Interactive Milestone Progress and Payout Calculator
summary: Add dynamic visual progress bar and payout calculator widget on Project Details page.
background: Clients and freelancers lack real-time visual feedback on remaining locked escrow funds vs approved payouts.
proposedSolution: Build interactive progress bar component calculating approved USDC, locked USDC, and estimated Blend yield.
acceptanceCriteria: Progress bar dynamically updates based on milestone states (Pending, Submitted, Approved).
Displays total paid USDC, locked USDC, and estimated Blend yield.
testingRequirements: Mock milestone states and test rendering across various budget splits.

title: [FEAT]: Advanced Filter and Search for Client/Freelancer Dashboards
summary: Enhance dashboard view with multi-criteria filtering and real-time search.
background: Users with multiple active projects struggle to find specific projects.
proposedSolution: Add filter controls for status, date range, client address, and budget threshold with URL query sync.
acceptanceCriteria: Real-time search filter without full page reloads.
URL query state sync (e.g. ?status=active&search=website).
testingRequirements: Verify filter logic with empty results and multi-select combinations.

title: [FEAT]: Toast Notification System for Stellar Wallet Signature States
summary: Provide feedback toasts during transaction signing and submission phases.
background: Users are confused while waiting for Freighter wallet signatures or ledger confirmation.
proposedSolution: Implement toast component showing signing, broadcasting, confirmation, and failure states with StellarExpert links.
acceptanceCriteria: Displays Stellar transaction hash with direct link to StellarExpert explorer.
Auto-dismisses on success after 5 seconds.
testingRequirements: Simulate rejected wallet signatures and network timeouts.

title: [FEAT]: Drag-and-Drop File Upload with Image Lightbox Preview
summary: Create file uploader supporting drag-and-drop attachment with image lightbox preview.
background: Uploading project specifications and proof of work requires clunky file inputs.
proposedSolution: Build drag-and-drop upload zone integrated with Supabase storage and a full-screen lightbox modal.
acceptanceCriteria: File size validation (< 10MB) and file type restriction (PDF, PNG, JPG, ZIP).
Lightbox modal allows full-screen preview and direct download.
testingRequirements: Test uploading invalid file extensions and large files.

title: [FEAT]: Global Dark / Light Theme Switcher
summary: Implement theme toggle matching modern glassmorphism design system.
background: The application currently defaults to dark mode without theme switching capability.
proposedSolution: Add theme context provider and toggle button storing choice in localStorage.
acceptanceCriteria: Persists preference in localStorage and respects system prefers-color-scheme.
Zero layout shift during theme transition.
testingRequirements: Verify toggle state across browser reloads.

title: [FEAT]: Responsive Mobile Navigation Drawer and Wallet Switcher
summary: Build smooth sliding mobile navigation drawer with role switcher and wallet disconnect.
background: Navigation controls wrap awkwardly on mobile devices below 480px width.
proposedSolution: Create responsive slide-over drawer containing menu links, active role toggle, and wallet status.
acceptanceCriteria: Touch-friendly hamburger menu triggers slide-over drawer.
Tested across screen widths down to 360px.
testingRequirements: Test open/close animations and breakpoint triggers on mobile viewports.

title: [FEAT]: Form Validation and Auto-Save Drafts for Project Creation
summary: Add Zod schema validation to project creation forms and auto-save progress.
background: Accidentally refreshing the project creation modal loses all typed milestone details.
proposedSolution: Validate form inputs with Zod and save form draft state to sessionStorage.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows clear inline error messages for invalid wallet addresses, negative amounts, or past due dates.
Restores draft automatically if page is refreshed.
testingRequirements: Submit invalid payloads and verify error messages.

title: [FEAT]: Milestone Delivery Verification Modal with Code/Link Submission
summary: Provide freelancers structured submission modal to attach PR links and demo URLs.
background: Submitting a milestone currently lacks a dedicated interface to attach proof of work.
proposedSolution: Build submission modal prompting for deliverable description, PR link, and live demo URL.
acceptanceCriteria: Validates URL syntax for GitHub PRs and demo links.
Triggers Soroban submit_milestone transaction upon form submission.
testingRequirements: Verify form submission and contract call trigger.

title: [FEAT]: On-Chain Transaction History Log Component
summary: Create audit trail component displaying historical contract calls for a project.
background: Users cannot view the complete chronological sequence of contract transactions.
proposedSolution: Build transaction history tab fetching and listing contract operations with block explorer links.
acceptanceCriteria: Displays timestamp, calling wallet address, operation type, and Stellar block explorer links.
testingRequirements: Verify history rendering for active and completed projects.

title: [FEAT]: Interactive Proposal Bidding List and Accept/Reject UI
summary: Create client workspace view to inspect freelancer proposals and trigger single-click acceptance.
background: Clients cannot compare candidate proposals directly inside the project details page.
proposedSolution: Add proposals tab to project workspace rendering applicant cover notes, portfolio links, and Accept/Deny actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Client can accept a proposal, binding freelancer address and updating project status.
Provides confirmation modal before denying competing proposals.
testingRequirements: Test proposal acceptance and denial state changes.

title: [FEAT]: Custom Loading Skeleton Screens across All Views
summary: Replace generic loading spinners with CSS skeleton loaders matching card layouts.
background: Spinner loaders cause abrupt layout shifts when data finishes loading.
proposedSolution: Create pulse-animated skeleton loader components mirroring project cards and table rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Pulse animation implemented using pure CSS.
Applied to dashboards, project detail pages, and proposal lists.
testingRequirements: Inspect visual transition from loading state to populated data.

title: [FEAT]: Export Project Report as PDF / JSON
summary: Add export button to generate downloadable PDF audit receipt containing project summary.
background: Freelancers and clients need official documentation of escrow payouts for tax/accounting.
proposedSolution: Integrate PDF generation library to create summary document with milestone payout hashes and timestamps.
acceptanceCriteria: PDF includes client address, freelancer address, total amount, milestone breakdown, and timestamp.
testingRequirements: Generate PDF report and verify data accuracy against on-chain records.

title: [FEAT]: Real-Time WebSocket Notification Toast Banner
summary: Display instant notification banner when project state changes or milestones are approved.
background: Users have to manually refresh the page to know if a client approved a milestone.
proposedSolution: Connect frontend client to Express WebSocket server and dispatch real-time toast alerts on contract events.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows instant toast alert when milestone is submitted, approved, or disputed.
Plays subtle notification sound effect (optional).
testingRequirements: Trigger backend event and verify toast appears without manual refresh.

title: [FEAT]: Arbiter Dispute Resolution Workspace Interface
summary: Build dedicated dashboard for assigned arbiters to review evidence and submit split payouts.
background: Arbiters lack a dedicated interface to inspect disputed projects and enter fund split allocations.
proposedSolution: Create arbiter workspace view rendering client vs freelancer claims, attachments, and resolution controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Calculates total remaining locked balance and validates split sum before transaction signing.
Only accessible if connected wallet matches designated project arbiter address.
testingRequirements: Connect non-arbiter wallet and verify access denial modal.

title: [FEAT]: Accessible Keyboard Navigation and Screen Reader Support
summary: Implement full ARIA attributes, focus rings, and keyboard navigation across modals.
background: Interactive modals and custom dropdowns are not fully accessible via keyboard (Tab/Escape).
proposedSolution: Audit all UI components for ARIA roles, focus management, and keyboard event handlers.
acceptanceCriteria: Modals close on Escape key press and trap focus within container.
Passes automated accessibility audit with zero critical errors.
testingRequirements: Navigate application using only keyboard and VoiceOver/NVDA.

title: [BEAT]: Automated Milestone Timelock Auto-Release Cron Service
summary: Implement Express background cron job to auto-release submitted milestones after 14 days.
background: If a client becomes unresponsive after a freelancer submits work, funds remain locked indefinitely.
proposedSolution: Create cron worker scanning for submitted milestones exceeding 14 days and triggering contract auto-release.
acceptanceCriteria: Cron job runs on configurable schedule (e.g. every hour).
Triggers auto-release contract invocation for unapproved submitted milestones past timelock duration.
testingRequirements: Mock milestone submission date in local database and trigger cron execution.

title: [BEAT]: Soroban RPC Contract Event Polling & Cache Sync
summary: Build background event poller scanning Soroban RPC ledger logs to update Supabase state.
background: On-chain state transitions (e.g. direct contract calls) need to sync reliably into off-chain database.
proposedSolution: Implement RPC polling loop querying getEvents and syncing project/milestone states into Supabase.
acceptanceCriteria: Handles network retries and keeps track of last ingested ledger sequence.
Updates project and milestone states in Supabase within 10 seconds of on-chain confirmation.
testingRequirements: Simulate Soroban contract execution and verify Supabase record update.

title: [BEAT]: Express API Rate Limiting & Security Hardening
summary: Add express-rate-limit and Helmet security headers to prevent DDoS and abusive requests.
background: Public backend API endpoints are susceptible to spam and malicious automated requests.
proposedSolution: Configure rate limiting middleware (100 requests / 15 minutes per IP) and strict Helmet HTTP security headers.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests when rate limit exceeded.
Injects strict Content Security Policy and HTTP security headers.
testingRequirements: Send automated request burst and verify 429 response.

title: [BEAT]: Supabase Presigned URL Upload Endpoint for Milestone Deliverables
summary: Build backend endpoint generating secure temporary presigned URLs for object uploads.
background: Direct public uploads to Supabase storage bypass backend validation checks.
proposedSolution: Create POST /api/v1/attachments/upload-url verifying user authorization before returning presigned upload token.
acceptanceCriteria: Validates file mime type and enforces 10MB size limit.
Returns short-lived (15 minute) presigned upload URL.
testingRequirements: Request upload URL with invalid mime type and verify 400 bad request response.

title: [BEAT]: Real-Time WebSocket Server Gateway for Contract Updates
summary: Implement WebSocket gateway dispatching live push notifications to connected clients.
background: Frontend clients currently rely on short polling to check status updates.
proposedSolution: Setup ws server module emitting event payloads whenever contract state changes are ingested.
acceptanceCriteria: Supports subscription channels by project ID (e.g. subscribe:project_1).
Broadcasts event payload within 500ms of database sync.
testingRequirements: Connect WebSocket client, broadcast mock event, and verify message receipt.

title: [BEAT]: Winston Structured Logging & Healthcheck Endpoint
summary: Implement JSON structured logging with log levels and GET /health check endpoint.
background: Console.log statements make production debugging and monitoring difficult.
proposedSolution: Integrate Winston logger writing structured JSON logs and create GET /health endpoint checking database connectivity.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /health returns HTTP 200 with database ping latency.
Logs errors with full stack traces and context payloads in JSON format.
testingRequirements: Query /health endpoint and verify response structure.

title: [BEAT]: Automated Email Notification Service via SendGrid / Resend
summary: Dispatch automated transactional emails when projects are created or milestones submitted.
background: Users miss important contract updates if they aren't actively viewing the web dashboard.
proposedSolution: Integrate transactional email client sending HTML notification emails on key milestone events.
acceptanceCriteria: Sends formatted email notification to client when milestone submitted.
Supports template customization and respects user notification preferences.
testingRequirements: Trigger email notification event and verify template rendering.

title: [BEAT]: Proposal Cleanup & Auto-Denial Worker
summary: Automatically reject remaining pending proposals once a client accepts an applicant.
background: When a proposal is accepted, competing proposals remain stuck in 'Pending' status.
proposedSolution: Build service logic updating status of remaining proposals to 'Denied' when proposal is accepted.
acceptanceCriteria: Atomically updates accepted proposal to 'Accepted' and all other project proposals to 'Denied'.
Sends notification to denied applicants.
testingRequirements: Accept a proposal with multiple active applicants and verify status updates.

title: [BEAT]: Redis Caching Layer for Frequently Queried Dashboard Data
summary: Cache project list and user profile database queries in Redis to improve response latency.
background: Repeated dashboard reloads create unnecessary read load on Supabase database.
proposedSolution: Integrate ioredis client caching GET /projects responses with 60-second TTL and cache invalidation on mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: Reduces dashboard query response time to < 20ms for cached hits.
Invalidates project cache key immediately when contract state changes.
testingRequirements: Benchmark API endpoint response time with Redis cache enabled.

title: [BEAT]: Database Migration Framework & Seeding Scripts
summary: Setup automated Supabase migration runner and local development seeding script.
background: New contributors need an easy way to seed mock projects and proposals in local development environment.
proposedSolution: Write TypeScript seed script generating mock projects, milestones, proposals, and attachments.
acceptanceCriteria: Command npm run db:seed populates local database with realistic test datasets.
Migrations apply cleanly in sequential order without errors.
testingRequirements: Run db:seed on fresh database instance and verify record population.

title: [SCAT]: Multi-Asset Support (USDC, EURC, XLM, PYUSD) for Soroban Escrow
summary: Support arbitrary Stellar Asset Contracts (SAC) beyond single default USDC token address.
background: Escrow contracts should support multi-currency settlement (e.g. EURC or native XLM wrapper).
proposedSolution: Refactor contract initialization to accept any valid Soroban SAC token address.
acceptanceCriteria: Successfully executes create_project and milestone transfers using various test SAC tokens.
Enforces token address validity checks.
testingRequirements: Write Rust unit tests verifying escrow initialization across 4 distinct token contracts.

title: [SCAT]: Reentrancy Protection and Safe Math Audit Guards
summary: Implement explicit reentrancy guards and overflow checks on all token transfer operations.
background: State transitions following external token transfer calls could be exposed to unexpected reentrancy vectors.
proposedSolution: Update project state variables prior to calling token.transfer and enforce checked arithmetic.
acceptanceCriteria: All math operations use checked_add, checked_sub, checked_mul.
State update precedes external token transfer invocation.
testingRequirements: Execute unit tests verifying math overflow panics correctly.

title: [SCAT]: Multi-Arbiter Dispute Committee Voting Mechanism
summary: Extend single arbiter model to 2-of-3 multi-signature arbiter dispute resolution committee.
background: Relying on a single arbiter address creates a single point of failure during dispute settlement.
proposedSolution: Store vector of 3 arbiter addresses and require 2 matching dispute split signatures to finalize payout.
acceptanceCriteria: Collects arbiter votes and executes payout split once threshold (2-of-3) is met.
Rejects unauthorized non-committee signers.
testingRequirements: Simulate 2 valid arbiter approvals and verify payout execution.

title: [SCAT]: Granular Contract Event Emission for Off-Chain Indexing
summary: Emit structured Soroban topics and data events for every state-changing contract function.
background: Off-chain indexers struggle to parse generic contract state updates without explicit event emissions.
proposedSolution: Emit env.events().publish() events with topics (e.g. ('project', 'created'), ('milestone', 'approved')).
acceptanceCriteria: Emits events containing project_id, timestamp, caller, and updated amounts.
Event topics follow standardized indexing convention.
testingRequirements: Assert event emissions in Rust test suite using env.events().all().

title: [SCAT]: On-Chain Client Rating and Feedback Score Data Structure
summary: Allow clients to attach a 1-5 star rating score when approving milestones, saved on-chain.
background: Freelancers want immutable on-chain proof of reputation and client feedback score.
proposedSolution: Store rating rating: Option<u32> inside Milestone struct and expose getter for freelancer reputation summary.
acceptanceCriteria: Enforces rating range (1 to 5).
Stores rating permanently in project storage.
testingRequirements: Submit milestone approval with rating = 5 and assert saved struct value.

title: [SCAT]: Automatic Emergency Freeze & Pause Admin Module
summary: Add admin emergency pause flag blocking new project creation during security vulnerabilities.
background: If a security flaw is discovered, maintainers need ability to pause new contract deposits.
proposedSolution: Implement require_not_paused guard on create_project controlled by admin multisig.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can set paused = true, preventing new project initialization.
Existing active project milestone approvals remain functional.
testingRequirements: Pause contract in test environment and verify create_project panics.

title: [SCAT]: Dynamic Protocol Fee Deduction Engine
summary: Deduct configurable platform service fee percentage (e.g. 1%) upon milestone settlement.
background: Platform sustainability requires deducting a small protocol service fee from milestone payouts.
proposedSolution: Calculate fee_amount = (milestone_amount * fee_basis_points) / 10000 and transfer fee to platform treasury.
acceptanceCriteria: Deducts fee accurately and transfers net amount to freelancer.
Fee percentage capped at maximum 5% (500 bps).
testingRequirements: Verify payout amounts split between freelancer and treasury address.

title: [SCAT]: Blend Yield Protocol Interface Adapter
summary: Implement Soroban contract adapter depositing idle principal into Blend pool contracts.
background: Escrowed funds earn zero yield while waiting for milestone delivery.
proposedSolution: Integrate Blend pool deposit and withdraw WASM interface bindings into contract lib.
acceptanceCriteria: Deposits 70% of total escrow principal into Blend lending contract upon create_project.
Withdraws principal + yield upon project completion.
testingRequirements: Mock Blend contract client in Rust test environment and test yield calculation.

title: [SCAT]: Storage TTL Extension Worker Module
summary: Extend Soroban instance and persistent storage TTL automatically to prevent data archival.
background: Soroban smart contract storage entries expire if TTL is not extended periodically.
proposedSolution: Add env.storage().persistent().extend_ttl() calls on project access.
acceptanceCriteria: Extends storage TTL to maximum allowable ledger threshold whenever project is accessed.
Prevents contract state archival.
testingRequirements: Verify storage TTL value using Soroban test utilities.

title: [SCAT]: Soroban Smart Contract Gas & Footprint Optimization Audit
summary: Optimize memory allocations and data structures to minimize Soroban invocation CPU gas.
background: Large vectors or unnecessary storage lookups increase transaction gas fees for users.
proposedSolution: Refactor data structures, replace large vectors with targeted storage keys, and optimize loops.
acceptanceCriteria: Reduces CPU instruction footprint by > 15% across contract calls.
Maintains 100% test suite pass rate.
testingRequirements: Compare CPU instruction count before and after optimization using Soroban budget metrics.

title: [FULL]: End-to-End Soroban Testnet Integration Test Suite
summary: Create automated Playwright e2e test suite simulating full escrow lifecycle on Stellar Testnet.
background: Manual browser testing of Freighter wallet connection and milestone release is slow.
proposedSolution: Write Playwright E2E tests mocking Freighter extension interactions and verifying flow execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Executes complete project creation, submission, approval, and payout flow.
Runs headlessly in CI pipeline.
testingRequirements: Run npx playwright test in CI environment.

title: [FULL]: Real-Time Analytics Dashboard for Platform Total Locked Value (TVL)
summary: Build public analytics page rendering platform TVL, active projects, and total yield generated.
background: Ecosystem participants lack visibility into aggregate platform usage metrics and active USDC volume.
proposedSolution: Create /analytics route rendering charts (Recharts) for TVL growth, volume, and active user stats.
acceptanceCriteria: Calculates TVL dynamically from smart contract balances.
Renders responsive area charts for monthly volume.
testingRequirements: Verify data consistency between analytics endpoint and on-chain total balances.

title: [FULL]: User Profile & Reputation Summary Component
summary: Build user profile page showcasing completed escrows, total earned/paid USDC, and rating score.
background: Freelancers need a public profile URL to showcase verified escrow completion metrics to prospective clients.
proposedSolution: Create /profile/[address] route compiling historical project records into a shareable badge card.
acceptanceCriteria: Displays total completed projects, total USDC volume, average client rating, and dispute ratio.
Includes copyable share link and OpenGraph image generator.
testingRequirements: Inspect profile card rendering for wallets with multiple completed projects.

title: [FULL]: Automated GitHub Repository CI Workflow Matrix Optimization
summary: Speed up GitHub Actions pipeline using parallel jobs and dependency caching.
background: The current CI pipeline executes jobs sequentially, leading to longer build wait times.
proposedSolution: Reorganize .github/workflows/ci.yml into parallel matrix jobs with cache-dependency-path configurations.
acceptanceCriteria: Reduces total CI pipeline execution time by > 40%.
Runs contract tests, backend build, and frontend build concurrently.
testingRequirements: Trigger GitHub Actions run and measure total execution duration.

title: [FULL]: Comprehensive Soroban SDK TypeScript Type Generation Pipeline
summary: Automate contract WASM interface to TypeScript type bindings generation using soroban-cli.
background: Manually typing Soroban contract invocation parameters leads to runtime payload errors.
proposedSolution: Add npm run generate-types script invoking soroban contract bindings typescript to produce exact types.
acceptanceCriteria: Generates strongly typed TypeScript functions matching contract methods.
Runs automatically before frontend build step.
testingRequirements: Execute typegen script and verify exported contract interface types.

title: [FULL]: Interactive OpenAPI / Swagger Documentation Gateway
summary: Embed interactive Swagger UI endpoint at GET /docs for backend REST API inspection.
background: External developers lack interactive API documentation to test Express backend endpoints.
proposedSolution: Integrate swagger-ui-express module reading swagger.yaml schema definition.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to GET /docs renders interactive Swagger UI with execute buttons.
Documents all project, proposal, attachment, and health endpoints.
testingRequirements: Inspect GET /docs in browser and send test request via Swagger UI interface.

title: [FULL]: Automated Database Migration Rollback and Disaster Recovery Tooling
summary: Create automated database backup and migration down scripts for Supabase schema management.
background: Schema migration failures require manual intervention without rollback scripts.
proposedSolution: Add down migration files for all Supabase migration steps and write automated backup script.
acceptanceCriteria: Executing migration rollback returns database schema cleanly to previous version.
Includes automated daily pg_dump backup script.
testingRequirements: Run migration up and down in local PostgreSQL instance.

title: [FULL]: Multi-Language Internationalization (i18n) Framework
summary: Add i18n support for English, Spanish, Portuguese, and French across all user interface views.
background: Stellar gig economy users reside globally and require localized language interfaces.
proposedSolution: Integrate next-intl framework with translation JSON dictionaries for key languages.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can select preferred language from header dropdown.
Persists language preference in URL path (e.g. /es/projects) and cookie.
testingRequirements: Switch language to Spanish and verify text translation across dashboard.

summary: Enable end-to-end encrypted messaging using wallet public keys for confidential project chatter.
background: Clients and freelancers need to exchange sensitive credentials (API keys, credentials) securely.

acceptanceCriteria: Messages are encrypted on client device before transmission to backend database.
Only wallet holding corresponding private key can decrypt message content.
testingRequirements: Inspect message payload in Supabase DB to verify cipher text state.

summary: Optimize Lighthouse score to > 95 across Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO.
background: Initial bundle size and unoptimized images impair mobile loading speeds.
proposedSolution: Optimize Next.js bundle, dynamic imports, image formats (WebP/AVIF), and critical CSS path.
acceptanceCriteria: Lighthouse audit score > 95 on Desktop and Mobile viewports.
First Contentful Paint (FCP) < 1.2s and Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) < 2.0s.
